```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the style for seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a categorical plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.boxplot(x='BMI Category', y='Sleep Duration', hue='Gender', data=data)

# Set the title and labels
plt.title('Sleep Duration by BMI Category and Gender', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=14)

# Adjust legend
plt.legend(title='Gender')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
